steps.content: To the MBCC Chief, or whoever gets this:
HURRY! PLEASE! SAVE HER!! Only you can save her. Please, I'm begging you!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Not all men are born equal.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Only the wise amass wealth, only the noble wield power. And only the most distinguished members of our inner circle are worthy of invitation here.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Deep in the high seas, hidden by the white sands, lies the ultimate resort, a haven of absolute safety, purity, and freedom.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Yes, <color=#fb9259>freedom</color>. The kind of true liberty the noble deserves. No prying eyes, no restraints, no taboos, no burdens. Come to indulge, or to trade. The choice is yours.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: When morality and law become nothing but cudgels abused by the common man, when beauty and passion are dulled by mediocrity... only this place remains a true paradise, where you'll rediscover life's most sumptuous, most fervent pleasures...

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Including perfect love.
[CG - Solo Opening Performance]
On stage, everything is silent under a soft light. A lone figure in gold begins to sing...

The backstage is a riot of noise and motion. Footsteps and voices mingle in the air, thick with perfume and sweat. Dozens of scantily clad dancers stand to one side, their faces blank, like a line of dolls awaiting their cues.
The newcomer, Sallie, is the only one on edge. She stands tensely in a corner, eyes glued to the stage.

steps.speaker: Man in the Shadow
steps.content: Get ready, wait for the signal.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...The signal?

steps.speaker: Man in the Shadow
steps.content: The signal for the show. From the woman on stage, the Jewel of Euphoria.
[Insert Video CG] Milly strips, group dance

steps.speaker: Magician
steps.content: Yeehaw!! Our turn!
[Cheers, whistles, applause]

As she tosses her glove skyward, the drums erupt. The spotlight on the singer dims, and the whole stage flares to life. The curtain flies open and a riot of color floods out, instantly taking over the performance.

Snow conjures snowflakes, Selene rises into the air. The centaur prances across the stage, the magician pulls a rabbit from a hat, and a man built like a French horn blasts a tune. Everyone is in action... except for one.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Ah!

The newcomer trips. The sudden glare of the lights has caught her off guard. She stumbles, missing a beat, and the swarm of bodies behind her knocks her to the floor. Her dress slips in the jostle, and she scrambles to cover herself in panic.
But when she looks up, she's met by a blast of laughter and jeers from the crowd. All she can see are flickering masks, their hollow eyeholes gaping with arrogance and greed.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Well well, it's a new one. That was a pretty fall. Great pose, too. Shows just the right amount.

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: Keep going! Want me to show you how to strip?
A few hands reach for her. She jerks away from their touch, almost screaming. The host cuts in, his voice gliding smoothly over the music to save the show.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Oh! Looks like this lovely dancer is just dying to give us a special performance! Easy now, dear guests—don’t forget to feast your eyes on the other beauties too, or they’ll start getting jealous!
The lights and the guests' attention are quickly drawn to the frolicking dancers on the other side. In the darkened corner, Sallie hears a low curse.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Get up! Useless piece of trash, screwing up on your first night. Don't you dare ruin everyone's fun. Dance!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Ngh...

Sallie struggles to her feet. Her ankle is twisted, forcing her to kick off her shoes. She looks up, hoping to find a discreet spot to stand, only to see that the other dancers have slithered into the champagne towers flanking the stage, bathing themselves in the syrupy honey wine and slathering it all over their skin.

Piece by piece, their clothing comes off, to the increasingly frenzied cheers from the crowd. What room is left for modesty here? For decorum? Morality? Sallie feels a sharp sting of pain, but in this place, tears will earn no sympathy.
They only make the masked beasts more excited.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome aboard... <color=#fb9259>Euphoria</color>!
